integrity: The upper bounds are analytic and dimension-independent. The bundled computation only checks the explicit equality witness numerically and is not used as an exhaustive or infinite proof. Originality is assessed against the defining primary article, targeted literature searches, published-finding corpus searches, and the available prior ledger; unindexed or differently phrased work remains a residual risk.
scientific_limitations: The exact evaluation is proved for real \(\ell_4(I)\) with at least two coordinates. The quartic argument does not by itself extend to other exponents or to the generalized variants of the constants.
title: Exact midline constants of real \(\ell_4\) sequence spaces
